reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: Unlike the other Needly toner pads, these pads have a jelly-like essence and are quite soothing. I have really sensitive acne-prone skin and noticed that high concentrations of vitamin c can cause me to break out but I haven’t had any issues with this product. Using them as a mask pack for 10 or so minutes has really helped lighten my dark spots and brighten my skin.
reviews.zh: 同其他 Needly 爽膚水棉唔同，呢啲棉有啲似啫喱嘅精華，用落好舒緩。我皮膚好敏感又容易爆瘡，一直留意到高濃度維他命 C 會令我爆瘡，但呢隻產品完全冇問題。當面膜用大約 10 分鐘，真係幫到我淡咗啲暗瘡印，皮膚都提亮咗。

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: My colleague asked me to buy this for her. She cant tolerate strong vitamin c serums so she is using this one instead. After a few weeks of using it, her face looks brighter and has the glass skin glow!
reviews.zh: 我同事叫我幫佢買呢隻。佢用唔到強效維他命 C 精華，所以轉用呢隻。用咗幾個禮拜之後，佢塊面望落光澤咗，有玻璃肌嘅光感！

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: I am not sure that these had any effect. They adhered well and didn't cause any irritation but I did not notice a difference in brightening effects. Very soaked and large pads which are great for the cheek area. I had hoped for better results.
reviews.zh: 我唔肯定呢啲有冇效果。貼面效果好又唔刺激，但我就睇唔到有咩提亮效果。棉片好濕潤又大片，貼面頰幾好用。本來期望有更好效果。

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: First I wish this came in a double pack like the other Needly toner pad. Overall for me this has been a really nice pad. I like the shape of it because it’s not fully rounded but has a nice crescent dip. I can place it right under my eye and it sits nicely along my upper cheek. It leaves the area much brighter. I do think a little more essence needs to be in container though. Would repurchase but I need a double set.
reviews.zh: 首先我希望呢隻可以好似其他 Needly 爽膚水棉咁出雙包裝。整體對我嚟講係一塊好好用嘅棉。我鍾意佢嘅形狀，因為唔係完全圓形，有一個好啱嘅月牙形凹位。可以貼喺眼下面，沿住上臉頰好貼服。用完嗰個位會亮咗。不過我覺得容器入面可以再多啲精華。會回購，但要雙裝先得。

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: Another needly favorite toner pad. Its very absorbing and light on skin. Made my acne blemishes color lighter. The only thing i don't like is the pads are small. I hope they can make it more bigger like their other pads. But overall i really love it! Will order more!
reviews.zh: 又一隻 Needly 嘅心水爽膚水棉。非常吸，而且用上皮膚好清爽。我啲暗瘡印淡咗色。唯一唔鍾意係棉片太細，希望佢哋可以好似其他棉片咁出大啲。但整體我真係好鍾意！會再落單！

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: This vitamin C essence pad is the best in the industry! The ingredients are noncomedogenic and fungal-acne safe! I have no broken out when I started using it. I recommend only using it every other day though, especially if you have sensitive skin. This product also helps my makeup look flawless throughout the day and my skin is glowing. It also helps with blemishes, both my red and dark scars!
reviews.zh: 呢隻維他命 C 精華棉係業界最靚！成分不致粉刺、對真菌性暗瘡都安全！我開用之後完全冇爆瘡。不過我建議隔日先至用一次，特別係敏感肌。呢隻產品仲幫到我妝容全日貼服無瑕，皮膚都光澤咗。對暗瘡印都有效，無論係紅印定深色疤都 work！

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: First and foremost, the infusion of Vitamin C is a standout feature. My skin feels instantly rejuvenated, and I've noticed a remarkable improvement in the overall brightness and evenness of my complexion. The jelly-like texture is a unique and enjoyable experience – it feels cool and refreshing upon application, providing a spa-like sensation at home.
reviews.zh: 首先，維他命 C 嘅注入係最大亮點。皮膚即時有煥活感，我留意到整體膚色顯著提亮、均勻咗。啫喱狀質地獨特又舒服——搽上去涼浸浸好清爽，屋企都有做 SPA 嘅感覺。

reviews.shade: NEEDLY Vita C Glow Jelly Pad 60P
reviews.text: I love these toner pads. Anything from needly in general has been amazing. I like to use these in the am as a sheet mask before I go in with the rest of my skincare and the glow I get lasts all day long.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲爽膚水棉。Needly 出嘅嘢整體都好用。我鍾意朝早當面膜用，之後先再落其他護膚品，嗰個光澤感全日都 keep 到。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
